source: Real REMAX Group October 2026 Agent Survey

headline: Buyers hold the
*most leverage yet*
slides.fig_caption: of agents say their market favors buyers, up from *55%*
slides.sub: A nine-point jump in one month, and the highest reading since the survey began in 2024.

slides.label: of agents say cancellations are running *above historical norms*
slides.body: 37% call them somewhat higher and 11% significantly higher. And 47% say deals fall through more often than they did six months ago.

slides.title: Most common reasons deals *fall through*
slides.note: When a deal dies, *46%* of agents say the home usually returns at the same price. 31% say it comes back with a cut.

slides.title: Protect the deal *early*
slides.body: Inspections and financing now sink the most contracts. Pre-listing inspections, fully vetted buyers and realistic pricing keep more deals alive. Agent optimism also rose to 53.0 from 45.8.
